reasoning: This is a standard UI chrome glyph for 'collapse' or 'exit fullscreen' (two arrows pointing inward). As an abstract directional symbol, it depicts no concrete object and only weakly maps to tasks about file compression or downsizing, while being very easy to confuse with expand/fullscreen arrows at small sizes.
